Camera not found. Is Send to Computer on, and is the camera on this Wi-Fi or hotspot? If it was used a moment ago, press Cancel on the camera and choose Send to Computer again.
Disconnected. The camera was sent to sleep.
Connection to the camera was lost. Start the send again on the camera and reconnect.
Joining the camera\'s Wi-Fi %1$s… Tap Connect in the system window.
Could not join the camera\'s Wi-Fi. On the camera leave the Send to Smartphone screen and open it again, then retry.
This NFC tag is not a Sony camera.
The N mark is for the mode \"Like Sony\'s app\". Change the mode in settings (top right).
Allow access to nearby Wi-Fi devices so the app can join the camera\'s network.
Point at the QR code on the camera\'s Send to Smartphone screen
This QR code has no camera Wi-Fi details.
Tap the picture to focus and set exposure there
Choose once; the app then always works this way.
Fast, RAW and JPEG, any pictures from the card. Needs one 2.4 GHz network for phone and camera: home Wi-Fi or this phone\'s hotspot.
Over the camera\'s own Wi-Fi, no router needed. You pick pictures on the camera; JPEG arrives.
On the camera choose Send to Computer. The phone and camera must share a 2.4 GHz network: home Wi-Fi, or the camera joined to this phone\'s hotspot.
On the camera choose Send to Smartphone and the pictures to send, then scan the QR code on its screen or touch the phone to the N mark.
The camera does not hand over several pictures at once in this mode. Choose one picture on the camera and connect again, or switch to \"Like a computer\" in settings for batches.
